items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And when you look back on it, I just had seen a promotional film that Jimmy Stewart had done... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: And when you look back on it, I just had seen a promotional film that Jimmy Stewart had done, trying to get pilots. And it worked amazingly well I guess.
